# S4.13 — hosted/subagent durability slices: lineage, provider environments, wakeups, intra-run branches

- **Ticket:** `docs/tickets/075_S4.13__hosted-lineage-and-durability.md`
- **Branch:** `svitali/harnessharness-s4.13` (stacked on `svitali/harnessharness-s4.12` @ `7b382b3`)
- **Requirement:** R-2.2.1¹, R-2.2.5¹, R-2.2.2², R-2.2.3 (C1 S4), R-2.2.4 (C2)
- **Closes:** AC-R-2.2.1-{16} · AC-R-2.2.2-{9} · AC-R-2.2.3-{10,13,15} · AC-R-2.2.4-{10} · AC-R-2.2.5-{13}
- **ADR:** `docs/adr/ADR-0305-s4.13-hosted-lineage-durability-rulings.md`
- **Deferrals opened:** DF-S4.13-1 (OQ-388 ratification half — measurement landed, WS-B1/K2 bound/policy ratification outstanding).
- **Deferrals closed:** none. DF-S4.10-1 (HUMAN-H1) stays **gate pending** — an operator gate, not a code state.

## What landed

**`hh-ledger` — the durability core:**

- `store.rs` — derived indexes (`by_event_id`, `by_class`,
  `ir_index`) maintained incrementally inside the same batch
  commit as the events they post; filtered `read` intersects
  postings then re-checks candidates against the full predicate —
  indexed results are byte-identical to the linear scan, and a
  rebuild derives the same postings (ADR-0305 D1; OQ-388
  measurement leg).
- `branch_ops.rs` (new, ~1130 lines) — intra-run branches
  (R-2.2.4): `open_branch`/`promote_branch`/`discard_branch`, the
  shared fold (kernel-owned `lifecycle.branch.{opened,disposed}`,
  `scope.branch_id`, `parent_event_id` = fork point), the
  SpeculationPolicy gate (`defer_irreversible` floor; `permissions[]`
  containment — `AuthorityWidening` at fork, AC-R-2.2.4-10),
  `max_concurrent_branches` (default 1, hard cap
  `MAX_INTRA_BRANCHES`), promote's explicit `releases` map
  (`DeferredReleaseMissing`), `committed{release: branch_promotion}`
  markers with fresh `attempt_no`/`fencing_token`, discard's
  per-phase effect termination (refuse/compensate/unknown/
  uncompensable), logical-HEAD rewind via `lifecycle.head.moved`,
  `control.budget.consumed` posting to `budget_slice_id`, and
  root-first `abandoned{budget_exhausted}` on budget exhaustion.
- `goal.rs` (new) — `open_inbox` (`run_kind = inbox`, `goal_ref`
  required, agent-only manifest cells cleared per ADR-0183 §C),
  `inbox_for_goal`, `continue_goal` (`continued_from{run_id,
  at_seq, head_hash}`, `activation_no`, `AlreadyContinued` fold
  across runs — restart-stable), `goal_subscribe`/`goal_occurred`
  (subscriptions owned `goal:<ref>` on the inbox run so they
  survive activation continuation).
- `wakeup.rs` — `schedule` (`interval`/`cron` grammar checked at
  subscribe — the evaluator never sees an undecodable form),
  `external` (admissible on every run kind; `source_ref`/`filter`
  members), `peer_message`; the unattended-trigger gate —
  `schedule`/`external` on `attendance = interactive` requires
  `policy.attendance_required` (`WakeupPolicyUnsupported`
  otherwise); durable `control.wakeup.occurred` before any fire;
  duplicate `occurrence_key` → audited `skipped{duplicate_
  occurrence}` (idempotent, never a second fire).
- `manifest.rs` — `goal_ref` coordinate; `run_kind = inbox`
  validation (`goal_ref` required; configuration/environment/
  metric cells forbidden).
- `classes.rs` — branch lifecycle + `lifecycle.session.resumed` +
  budget-exhausted/`release`/`decider`/`permissions` audit-field
  registrations; `hosted_lowering` pairs `session.resumed`.
- `errors.rs` — `UnknownBranch`, `BranchDisposed`,
  `SpeculationViolation`, `DeferredReleaseMissing`,
  `AlreadyContinued`, `GoalFinished`, `TriggerUnsupported`,
  `WakeupPolicyUnsupported`, `SubscriptionLimit`.
- `export.rs` — `export_audit_view_with_lineage`: `lineage[]`
  root-first (`{run_id, up_to_seq, head_hash}` — the
  `Store::lineage` shape) rides the export verbatim.
- `saga.rs` — the `compensate` seam `discard` hands its
  compensable intents to.

**`hh-env` — provider classes + lifecycle:**

- `provider.rs` (new) — the `ProviderAdapter` seam (`provision`/
  `suspend`/`resume`/`teardown`/`meters`) + the `ProviderMeter`
  record (declared vs unreported partitioning).
- `driver.rs` — `remote_ephemeral`/`remote_persistent`/
  `provider_hosted` provision requires a registered adapter
  (typed refusal otherwise); `suspend`/`resume` gated on the
  class's declared `SuspendKind` (`Unknown` → `UnknownCapability`,
  never coerced) with `suspended_ms` accrual; detach semantics —
  ephemeral tears down, persistent/provider-hosted survive;
  `detach_to_child` ownership handoff; `derive` `share` mode with
  resource-key leases (a shared mutable environment requires the
  lease set); parent-teardown cascade.
- `handle.rs` — `Suspended`/`Detached`/`Unreachable` states,
  `HostedBinding` (participant-origin rows; explicit unobserved
  transitions), meter accounting, provider capability
  declarations.
- `events.rs` — `action.environment.{suspend.requested,
  suspended, resumed, detach.*}` payloads.

**`hh-hosting` — the lift table:**

- `hosted_status.rs` (new) — `map_tool_call_status`: the five-state
  hosted stream → native effect classes (`pending`→`intended`,
  `in_progress`→`committed`, `completed`→`observed{applied}`,
  `failed`→`observed{not_applied}`, `cancelled`→`unknown{
  cancelled}`); an undeclared spelling → `unknown{executor_error}`
  with `status_raw` preserved — never `read_only`, never a
  fabricated terminal (AC-R-2.2.2-9).
- `proj.rs` — `session.resumed` → `lifecycle.session.resumed`
  (ADR-0305 D2 — participant-origin rows never mint kernel
  lifecycle transitions); `stop_reason_raw` lifted through the
  table on `turn.finished`; unknown kinds →
  `lifecycle.hosted.native_record` (CC3 — nothing drops).

**`hh-mcp` (already landed, verified)** — target-side
idempotency-key forwarding: `params.target` carries the kernel's
`idempotency_key` verbatim on every `tools/call`
(`crates/hh-mcp/src/executor.rs` + `client.rs`/`server.rs`;
§5d.4 D4).

**`hh-embed` + schema:**

- `durability_ops.rs` (new) — `branch.open`/`promote`/`discard`,
  `continue_goal`, `open_inbox`, `subscribe`, `record_occurrence`,
  `env.suspend`/`env.resume`; the discard arm carries the honest
  `compensation_failed{boundary: no_dispatch}` record (ADR-0305
  D3 — the embed boundary holds no compensator).
- `envops.rs` — `env.derive` admits `mode: "share"` +
  `on_parent_end: "detach_to_child"`.
- `ops.rs`/`lib.rs` — the op registry entries (experimental tier),
  the `BranchOpenParams`/`ContinueGoalParams`/`OpenInboxParams`/
  `SubscribeParams`/`RecordOccurrenceParams` shapes.
- Regenerated `schema/hh-embed-1.schema.json` +
  `crates/hh-embed-client-generated/src/generated.rs`
  (drift-checked; schema-hash parity across the spawned-process
  boundary re-verified after `cargo build -p hh-kernel`).

**`hh-fleet`/`hh-subagent`** — `Trigger::External` gains
`source_ref`/`filter` (the §5a.3 `external{source_ref, filter}`
form); the fleet admissibility test updated — `external` left the
fleet-only boundary at S4.13, `manual` stays fleet-bound,
`environment_ready` keeps its refusal (ADR-0305 D4).

| AC | Test | What it proves |
|----|------|----------------|
| AC-R-2.2.1-16 (index latency) | `ac_r_2_2_1_16_class_filtered_read_matches_linear_semantics`, `ac_r_2_2_1_16_index_survives_rebuild_identically`, `ac_r_2_2_1_16_latency_1e5_fixture` (ignored-by-default; run explicit) | indexed read ≡ linear scan; rebuild posts identically; 10⁵-event filtered read of 100 results ≈ 15 ms (result-proportional — OQ-388 measured) |
| AC-R-2.2.2-9 (hosted status map) | `s4_13_hosted_status_map_five_plus_unknown`, `s4_13_lift_stop_reason_table_and_unknown_preserved` (hh-hosting) | five-state map incl. `cancelled`→`unknown{cancelled}`; undeclared → `unknown{executor_error}` + `status_raw`; never `read_only` |
| AC-R-2.2.3-10 (continuation chain) | `ac_r_2_2_3_10_continuation_chain_and_inbox` (hh-ledger) | `continued_from` verifies across activations; inbox run carries the goal-scoped subscriptions; second continuation from one head → `AlreadyContinued` |
| AC-R-2.2.3-13 (hosted resume) | `s4_13_session_resumed_lifts_to_native_class` (hh-hosting) | `session.resumed` lifts onto the registered native class with payload verbatim; ADR-0305 D2 records the `lifecycle.session.resumed` target (participant rows never mint `run.resumed`) |
| AC-R-2.2.3-15 (KP-16…21 / KP-F1…F5) | `hh-subagent/tests/s4_6.rs` (KP-16/19/21 rows), `g6_merge_hash_order_independent` (s4_8), `ac5_restore_equivalence` + `reconcile` (hh-fleet) | no duplicate effect; merge after restore equals merge without crash (`merge_hash`); restore(fleet)→reconcile yields the same actions — pre-existing suites re-verified green under the S4.13 wakeup changes |
| AC-R-2.2.4-10 (budget + authority) | `ac_r_2_2_4_10_authority_widening_at_fork`, `ac_r_2_2_4_10_branch_spend_posts_to_slice_and_root_first_abandons` (hh-ledger); `s4_13_branch_lifecycle_over_the_boundary` (embed) | `AuthorityWidening` at fork on unheld permission/widening policy; spend posts to `budget_slice_id`; root-first exhaustion → `abandoned{budget_exhausted}` |
| AC-R-2.2.5-13 (hosted env mapping) | `ac_r_2_2_5_13_hosted_rows_carry_participant_origin`, `s4_13_provider_class_requires_registered_adapter`, `s4_13_provider_lifecycle_suspend_resume_meters_teardown`, `s4_13_remote_ephemeral_detach_tears_down_persistent_does_not`, `s4_13_derive_share_leases_resource_keys` (hh-env) | participant-origin rows on hosted handles; adapter gate; suspend/resume/meters/teardown; ephemeral-vs-persistent detach; `share` requires resource-key leases |
| Boundary ops | `s4_13_branch_lifecycle_over_the_boundary`, `s4_13_wakeup_subscribe_and_idempotent_occurrence`, `s4_13_inbox_and_continue_goal_over_the_boundary`, `s4_13_env_suspend_resume_over_the_boundary` (hh-embed conformance) | routing, experimental gate, widening→`AuthorityViolation`, duplicate occurrence → `skipped`, session-free inbox, typed refusals |
| `removability(0…3)` | `scripts/check-removability.sh` | see Verification log |

## Notes / deviations

- **OQ-388** — the measurement half is discharged by the
  executable fixture (result-proportional bound confirmed); the
  register's ratification act (WS-B1/K2) is DF-S4.13-1. ADR-0305
  D1 fixes the implemented maintenance policy.
- **`session.resumed` lift target** — `lifecycle.session.resumed`,
  not `lifecycle.run.resumed` (ADR-0305 D2; a participant-origin
  row asserting a kernel lifecycle transition would be authority
  widening, CC2).
- **Boundary `discard`** — the compensable arm records
  `compensation_failed{boundary: no_dispatch}` (ADR-0305 D3); the
  saga compensator stays with the orchestrator (CC10).
- **Transient infra issue during the run** — one `cargo test
  --workspace` pass stalled when macOS's exec assessment
  (syspolicyd) wedged on a freshly-linked test binary; the run was
  restarted with output to a file and completed green.
